Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 1 Purpose of the policy
Pulse believes in building a long-term employment relationship with its employees. To support this, every employee joining us will be given a brief period of time to get acclimatized to the company's goals and culture. This policy provides a clear guidance of all the provisions and transparent procedures to evaluate the performance during this period.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 2 Scope of the policy
This policy is applicable to all new joiners working at Corporate, Depot, R&D, Factory and Field Force of the Pulse Group.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 3 Probation period
3.1 The probation period is a brief time given to the employees for a period as mentioned below so that they clearly understand the job requirement and learn the skills required to perform their tasks.

3.2 It is the joint responsibility of the HR and the reporting manager to support newly joined employees to understand the company goals, individual goals and company's working culture.

3.3 During this period, the reporting manager will provide necessary technical and functional training to the employees so that they understand what is expected of them and how to make impactful contributions to the company.

3.4 The performance targets for the assessment year (i.e. date of joining till 31 of March) shall be clearly communicated to the employees by the reporting manager within 5 working days of employee joining.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 3 Probation period
Table:
| Level | Probation Period (from Date of Joining) |
| --- | --- |
| All levels | 6 months |

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 4 Confirmation process
4.1. Employee's confirmation of services will be subject to successful completion of the probation period.

4.2. Employee's Performance shall be reviewed twice during the probation period

4.2.1. At the end of 3 months of probation period (quarterly) and

4.2.2. After completion of 6 months' probation period

4.3. HR shall initiate the process during the last week of the assessment periods respectively through a Confirmation Appraisal Form (Annexure 1).

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 5 Recommendations > 5.1 Quarterly review
5.1.1. During the quarterly review, the reporting manager shall conduct a formal appraisal discussion with the employee, provide necessary feedback on employee's performance and ask for any clarifications and support needed by the employee.

5.1.2. Reporting manager after discussing with the HOD, shall document the discussion on the confirmation appraisal form and submit the form to HR.

5.1.3. The main objective of this process is to provide interim feedback to the employee and shall not be used to recommend confirmation or extension of services.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 5 Recommendations > 5.2 Probation review
5.2.1. After completion of probation period, the reporting manager shall conduct a formal appraisal discussion with the employee and shall provide detailed feedback on the performance; accomplishments and areas of improvements during the probation period.

5.2.2. Reporting manager after discussing with the HOD, shall document the discussion on the confirmation appraisal form along with necessary recommendation i.e. confirmation of services or probation extension and submit the form to the HR for further processing.

5.2.3. After the employee successfully completes the probation period, as per the recommendations from the reporting manager and HOD, HR will issue a Confirmation of Services Letter (Annexure 2) to the employee.

5.2.4. Trainees who successfully complete their probation period will be given an appointment letter to the next level.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 6 Extension of probation period
6.1. In the event of the employee not meeting the desired performance expectation, the reporting manager in consultation with the HOD, can recommend for extension of the probation period.

6.2. The extension period shall not exceed 3 months and the recommendation should be justified with supporting data in the confirmation appraisal form.

6.3. After review by the HR, the employee shall be issued a Probation Extension Letter (Annexure 3).

6.4. The employee's performance is again evaluated by reporting manager, HOD and HR in the last week of the extension period as defined in section 5.2 of this policy.

6.5. If there is a visible improvement in the performance of the employee, the services will be confirmed effective the date of completion of extension period.

6.6. If there is no improvement, on the account of poor performance, the employee will be asked to leave the company after necessary discussions with HOD and HR.

6.7. The exit process will be carried out as per the Employee Separation Policy of the company.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 7 Administration
HR department will administer this policy.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 8 Exceptions
Any exceptions to the policy shall be approved by Head HR.

Policy: Probation and Confirmation Policy (Version V.01, effective 2026-01-01)
Policy ID: probation-confirmation-policy
Section: 9 Annexure
1. Confirmation Appraisal Form

2. Confirmation of Services Letter

3. Probation Extension Letter The Management reserves its right to amend the policy as per the business need and if appropriate at any time. Such amended policy will be communicated to the employees through the appropriate channel.
